- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provençal was primarily used in literature and poetry in the past but has evolved to include music, cinema, and television.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Today, there are several Provençal-language radio and television channels, and numerous websites and online publications that feature the language.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provençal usage has diversified to include social media, podcasts, and video platforms.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provençal is not widely used for official business purposes, school, or administrative documentation, which are still conducted in French.
